children: rose 0.58% intraday after reporting August core net new assets of $64.8 billion, up 46% and a record for the month. Total client assets reached $13.41 trillion, up 19% from a year earlier. New brokerage accounts came to 424,000, an 11% increase.

Margin balances ended August at $177.6 billion, up 58% from year-end and 92% year over year. This figure includes margin loans and short credits tied to long and short strategies from which Schwab earns a fixed net yield, with August margin loans at $53.7 billion and short credits at $55.8 billion. The same client demand for those strategies drove transactional sweep cash $6.5 billion higher to $483.3 billion.

Derivatives made up 24.2% of total trades, up 360 basis points on the month, while client cash slipped to 8.8% of client assets. Daily average trades of 9.8 million fell 16% from July but ran 37% above August 2025.

title: Schwab Books a Record August With $64.8 Billion of Net New Assets
